De-risk before committing, with the failure signal declared IN ADVANCE. Thermite's own SPIKE-1 named '>40 lemmas' as its failure signal and SPIKE-2 committed to reporting its hit rate 'whatever it is'. A spike whose failure condition is decided afterwards is not a spike, it is a demo. Throwaway by construction: the anchor spike was a branch that did not build.

```day-atom
{"_version":2,"in":["probe-verdict"],"out":["spike-result"],"next":["design-pass"],"revisits":["language-probe"]}
```
